title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2004, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2004, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
